data: NVIDIA's fiscal 2023 results show flat sales but sharply weaker profitability. Revenue was $27.0 billion in fiscal 2023, compared with $26.9 billion in fiscal 2022, growth of just 0.2%. Net income fell 55.2%, from $9.8 billion in fiscal 2022 to $4.4 billion in fiscal 2023. That points to significant margin pressure on an essentially unchanged top line. Cash generation also weakened. Operating cash flow fell from $9.1 billion in fiscal 2022 to $5.6 billion in fiscal 2023. Liquidity nonetheless improved, with cash and cash equivalents rising from $2.0 billion to $3.4 billion. The balance sheet shrank slightly. Total assets declined from $44.2 billion in fiscal 2022 to $41.2 billion in fiscal 2023, while total liabilities rose from $17.6 billion to $19.1 billion. We see the earnings recovery as the key watch item.
